about.title: About
paragraphs: My interest in AI began during my university years, when I started experimenting with the first LLMs and chatbots that could communicate in natural language and help with programming tasks. At first this steered me towards practical uses of NLP and generative AI; later I became more interested in what happens behind the technology. In Python I worked on machine learning and image processing projects, training models and working with neural networks and computer vision, and alongside them I studied how machine learning, deep learning, algorithms and the underlying mathematics work. In my thesis I studied the practical use of language models and prompting techniques.

I currently work as an AI developer. Besides building LLM-based systems, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, document processing, OCR, AI-based text processing and Python systems, my work also covers classical software engineering and optimization problems. I am particularly interested in integrating AI capabilities into reliable, well-designed software systems, so I want to understand the technologies behind them, not just use them. In the coming years I want to grow towards an AI Engineer / Software Engineer role where I can independently design and build complex AI-based systems while keeping a research and experimental mindset.

For me, AI should not replace engineering thinking but serve as its tool. I use LLMs and vibe-coding-style tools mainly for faster prototyping, learning, experimenting and supporting the development process, while I consider it important to truly understand the code, the architecture and the technologies used. I like to examine a problem from several angles, experiment with different solutions, and then turn the working result into a real software system.
